newsitem.title: INDIA: Chidambaram absent from new Indian government.
newsitem.headline: Chidambaram absent from new Indian government.

text.p: P. Chidambaram, finance minister in India's outgoing government, was not included on Monday among ministers in Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's new council of ministers, authorities said.

Chidambaram's regional Tamil Maanila Congress party decided on Saturday not to join the government after the United Front coalition passed over the party's leader, G.K. Moopanar, and instead chose Gujral as the alliance's new leader.
Gujral retained the entire cabinet of outgoing prime minister H.D. Deve Gowda except Chidambaram and former labour minister M. Arunachalam, authorities said.

After he was sworn in, the new prime minister told reporters that he would keep the foreign and finance ministry portfolios for himself. All other ministers would retain the jobs they held under Deve Gowda, Gujral said.
